title: SQLFlow pipeline
description: A SQLFlow data pipeline: read a source, evolve the target schema, and load it.

name.description: Unique pipeline name. Also the stable flow identity (a deterministic GUID is derived from it).

source.description: Where the data is read from.

location.description: Path, folder, or URI to read. For CSV/JSON: a file or a folder (with options.srcFile).

options.description: Reader-specific options. The CSV, XLS, JSON, XML, and Parquet keys are listed below; values are strings. Parquet is columnar and self-describing, so it uses only the shared file-selection, provenance, key, and schema options (plus partitionList/expectedColumnCount).

sheetName.description: XLS: worksheet to read. Empty = first sheet; with useSheetIndex it is a 0-based index.

sheetRange.description: XLS: cell range to read, e.g. A1:D100. Empty = whole used sheet.

useSheetIndex.description: XLS: treat sheetName as a 0-based sheet index instead of a name.

rootPath.description: JSON: JSONPath the records live under, e.g. $.data.records. $ = document root. An array there fans out to one record per element.

includePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated whitelist of paths to flatten. Empty = flatten everything.

excludePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated paths whose subtree is dropped (no column).

jsonPaths.description: JSON: comma-separated paths kept verbatim as a single JSON-string column instead of being flattened.

explodePaths.description: JSON: comma-separated array paths to explode - each element becomes its own output row. Several exploded arrays cross-product.

pathAliases.description: JSON schema-evolution aliases: map version-specific paths to one column, e.g. person_name=$.user.name|$.user.firstName; id=$.id|$.userId. A missing source path is filled by another (never nulled).

separator.description: JSON: separator joining nested keys into a column name (default _), e.g. address_city.

maxDepth.description: JSON: maximum nesting depth flattened into columns; deeper values become JSON strings. Default 10.

arrayHandling.description: JSON: how an unconfigured array becomes a column. to_json (default) keeps it as a JSON string; explode makes every array emit one row per element.

joinSeparator.description: JSON/XML: separator used when array/repeat handling is join (default comma).

rowXPath.description: XML: XPath selecting the row (record) elements (carries the original hierarchyIdentifier). Empty = each direct child of the root; . = the root element itself.

xmlPaths.description: XML: comma-separated paths kept verbatim as a single XML-fragment column (the XML analog of jsonPaths). Paths use / syntax, e.g. /meta, /vendor.

repeatHandling.description: XML: how repeating sibling elements become a column. to_xml (default) keeps them as one XML fragment; explode makes each element its own row.

includeAttributes.description: XML: whether attributes become columns (default true). An attribute is addressed as /@name.

attributePrefix.description: XML: prefix applied to an attribute's column name (default @). Set e.g. attr_ to keep an attribute distinct from a same-named element.

stripNamespacePrefixes.description: XML: strip namespace prefixes from element/attribute names so paths and columns use local names (default true).

hierarchyIdentifier.description: XML: legacy alias for rowXPath (the original PreIngestionXML column name).

partitionList.description: Parquet: partition column list carried for metadata fidelity (Hive-style datasets). Recorded, not used to drive reads.

srcPathMask.description: Regex over the full path (name and/or folder) to further filter files.

searchSubDirectories.description: Recurse into sub-folders of the location.

delimiter.description: Column delimiter. Use \t for tab. Default comma.

qualifier.description: Text qualifier that lets a field contain the delimiter or a newline. Default double quote.

escapeCharacter.description: Escapes a qualifier inside a quoted field.

commentCharacter.description: Lines beginning with this character are skipped.

columnWidths.description: Comma-separated fixed column widths for fixed-width files (no delimiter).

header.description: First row holds column names. Default true. False generates Column1..N.

firstRowSetsExpectedColumnCount.description: Use the first row's column count as the expected count.

expectedColumnCount.description: Expected number of columns; rows that differ raise an error. 0 disables.

srcEncoding.description: Source encoding: UTF8 (default), Unicode (UTF-16), UTF32, ASCII.

skipStartingDataRows.description: Number of leading data rows to drop (a preamble).

skipEndingDataRows.description: Number of trailing data rows to drop (a footer).

trim.description: Trim surrounding whitespace from every value (true/false).

stripControlChars.description: Remove non-printable control characters from values.

maxRows.description: Cap how many rows are loaded; 0 = all.

maxBufferSize.description: Parser read buffer size in bytes.

showPathWithFileName.description: Store the full path (not just the name) in FileName_DW.

includeFileName.description: Inject the FileName_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileDate.description: Inject the FileDate_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileRowDate.description: Inject the FileRowDate_DW provenance column (default true).

includeFileSize.description: Inject the FileSize_DW provenance column (default true).

includeDataSet.description: Inject the DataSet_DW provenance column (default true).

includeRowNumber.description: Inject the RowNumber_DW provenance column (default true).

includeHashKey.description: Inject HashKey_DW: a per-row hash (varbinary) for dedup when there is no business key.

hashKeyColumns.description: Comma-separated columns to hash. Empty = all source columns (system columns excluded).

hashKeyType.description: Hash algorithm: SHA2_512 (default), SHA2_256, SHA1, MD5.

includeConcatKey.description: Inject ConcatKey_DW: a readable composite key built from the chosen columns.

concatKeyColumns.description: Comma-separated columns to concatenate. Empty = all source columns.

initFromFileDate.description: Earliest file date to include (inclusive). Read from the file's modified time by default, or from the path/name when fileDate.from is set. yyyy-MM-dd or a timestamp.

initToFileDate.description: Latest file date to include (inclusive). Read from the same source as initFromFileDate.

fileDate.from.description: Where the date window reads each file's business date: modified (file timestamp, the default), path (Hive partitions or a pattern in the folder path), or name (a pattern in the file name). A path date lets discovery prune whole out-of-window partition folders.

fileDate.hive.description: With fileDate.from: path, read the date from Hive key=value partition tokens (year=2025/month=03/day=05). Mutually exclusive with fileDate.pattern.

fileDate.pattern.description: Regex yielding the date, for fileDate.from path or name. Named groups year/month/day/hour, or unnamed groups in that order. Missing finer parts widen the window (a year-only match spans the whole year). Mutually exclusive with fileDate.hive.

fileDate.partitions.description: For a duckdb source with a Hive fileDate: the ordered partition columns to push the window down onto (default year,month,day). Only year, month, and day are recognized.

copyToPath.description: After a successful load, copy each ingested file here.

zipToPath.description: After a successful load, compress each ingested file to here.

srcDeleteIngested.description: Delete each file after it is ingested.

srcDeleteAtPath.description: Delete the file at the source path after ingestion.

defaultColDataType.description: SQL type for raw columns when creating the target (overrides the global default).

target.description: The SQL Server table to load into.

connection.description: Connection string, or a reference like ${env:SQLFLOW_DW}. Never a raw secret committed to the file.

schema.description: Schema evolution policy and column typing.

evolve.description: create: create if missing, never alter. widen: add new source columns. strict: fail if the source has columns the target lacks.

defaultColumnType.description: SQL type for raw (untyped) columns when creating the table. Default varchar(255).

overrides.description: Per-column type/nullability overrides keyed by column name.

type.description: Explicit SQL type for this column.

load.description: How rows are written to the target.

mode.description: append: add rows. truncate-load: empty the target first (full refresh).

tableLock.description: Take a table lock during the bulk load. Default true.

manageIndexes.description: On an existing table, disable non-clustered indexes before the load and rebuild them after.

incremental.description: Incremental load: probe the target for a watermark and read only newer files. The target table is the state; no control database is needed.

table.description: Fully qualified table to probe for the watermark. Defaults to this flow's target.

dateColumn.description: Date/datetime column whose MAX is the watermark. Default FileDate_DW.

overlapDays.description: Days subtracted from the watermark to re-read a safety window. Default 0.

fullLoad.description: Ignore the watermark and reload everything.

transform.description: Pre-ingestion transform: type inference and authored per-column transforms over the raw landing table, projected into a typed view the target is loaded through.

inferTypes.description: Infer optimal SQL types for the raw string columns.

onConvertError.description: When a value cannot convert: produce NULL, or fail loudly.

threshold.description: Fraction of values that must convert for a type to be chosen (0..1).

sample.description: Rows to sample for inference; 0 = all.

preserveLeadingZeros.description: Keep values with leading zeros as strings rather than numbers.

generateView.description: Generate the typed transformation view [schema].[v<Table>] over the flow's loaded table as a post-process (default true); downstream flows read the view for correct types. Set false to skip it.

columns.description: Authored per-column transforms (the source of truth), one entry per column that is cast, renamed, computed, or dropped. An authored transform overrides inference for that column; inference fills the rest.

name.description: The raw source column the transform applies to (for a virtual column, the name of the computed column).

expr.description: SQL expression producing the value; @ColName is substituted with the quoted source column. Required for a virtual column.

as.description: Output column name (alias) in the view. Default: name.

type.description: Declared target SQL type, e.g. varchar(50). With no expr, the transform is CAST(@ColName AS type).

order.description: Column position in the view. Lower first; unset columns keep natural order.

virtual.description: A computed column with no raw source counterpart. Requires expr; @ColName is not valid here.

excludeFromView.description: Compute nothing into the view's final projection; drop this column from the view output.

desiredIndexes.description: One or more CREATE INDEX statements. Built when the table is created; an existing table's indexes are disabled/rebuilt around the load instead.

preProcess.description: SQL run on the target before the load (statements or EXEC a procedure).

postProcess.description: SQL run on the target after the load.
